'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Matt Sokol LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet. Defensive Shields writes "15 Shields" on line 1 and leaves lines 2–15 blank; those slots are not invented. Line 9 Fuel Station and line 46 Hunt Gift (V) are unread. Line 40 Gola has no matching printed title. Day 2 was Yavin 4 / Restore Freedom (a different 60; not copied here).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
